cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.19)
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Toolchain file must be passed via -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=...
# It can be generated by arch/gen_toolchain.py for the provided architecture.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
project(XIOS
    LANGUAGES CXX Fortran
    VERSION 3)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Library sources
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(xios)

# Core sources
add_subdirectory(src)

# Vendored extern sources
add_subdirectory(extern/remap)
add_subdirectory(extern/cpptrace)
add_subdirectory(extern/rapidxml)
add_subdirectory(extern/boost_extraction)
add_subdirectory(extern/blitz)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Find modules
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_package(HDF5 REQUIRED)
find_package(NetCDF REQUIRED)
find_package(MPI REQUIRED)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Links and definitions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# XIOS dependencies
target_link_libraries(xios PUBLIC cpptrace blitz)
target_link_libraries(xios PUBLIC rapidxml boost_extraction)
target_link_libraries(xios PUBLIC NetCDF::C HDF5::C MPI::MPI_CXX MPI::MPI_Fortran)

# OASIS
if(XIOS_WITH_OASIS)
    find_package(OASIS REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(xios PRIVATE OASIS::OASIS)
endif()

# Python bindings
if(XIOS_USE_PYTHON)
    find_package(Python REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(xios PRIVATE Python::Python)
endif()

# Fortran modules
set_target_properties(xios PROPERTIES
    Fortran_MODULE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/modules")

target_include_directories(xios PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/modules>
)

# Extra keys from make_xios (parallel compression detection, oasis keys, etc.)
target_compile_definitions(xios PRIVATE ${XIOS_CPPKEY})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Executables
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_xios_executable(xios_server         "src/xios_server.f90"           Fortran)
add_xios_executable(generic_testcase    "src/test/generic_testcase.f90" Fortran)
add_xios_executable(generate_interfaces "src/generate_interfaces.cpp"   CXX)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install rules
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Install library and headers
install(TARGETS xios
    LIBRARY DESTINATION lib
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)

install_sources(FILES XIOS_INSTALL_SOURCES DESTINATION inc)
install_sources(FILES XIOS_INSTALL_PYTHON DESTINATION lib/python/xios)

# Install executables
install(TARGETS ${XIOS_EXECUTABLES} RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)

# Install Fortran modules
install(DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/modules/"
    DESTINATION inc
    FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.mod")

# Library alias
add_library(XIOS::XIOS ALIAS xios)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
message(STATUS "")
message(STATUS "CMake configuration")
message(STATUS "  Build type     : ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
message(STATUS "  Shared library : ${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS}")
message(STATUS "  C++ compiler   : ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}")
message(STATUS "  Fortran        : ${CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER}")
message(STATUS "")
